about_the_game:
Developed by Hammer Forge Games, Vault of Fallen is a brutal dark fantasy first-person action game set on a cursed island lost to war and time. Blending tight gunplay with satisfying hack-and-slash sword combat, Vault of Fallen throws you into a relentless battle against undead warriors brought back through a deadly fusion of ritual magic and twisted science. Wield a shotgun in one hand, a sword and shield in the other, and carve your path through a world of blood, ash, and ancient ruin.

STORY:

As World War II rages across the globe, your aircraft crashes on a remote island long forgotten by history. Beneath the surface lies the Vault—a massive underground structure where a deranged scientist once used dark experiments to raise the dead.
Now the dead walk again. Armed with stolen technology and cursed power, skeletal warriors and corrupted beasts roam the island.
You are alone, trapped, and the only one left who can stop the rising tide.

KEY FEATURES:

Hybrid First-Person Combat

Switch seamlessly between guns, swords, and shield-based combat. Blast through enemies at range with powerful firearms, then close the gap and slash, block, and bash your way through crowds of the undead in visceral hack-and-slash style.

Relentless Undead Foes

Face cursed warriors, reanimated beasts, and grotesque experiments from another era. Every enemy is designed to test your timing, strategy, and aggression.

Dark, Atmospheric World

Journey through eerie ruins, forgotten temples, war-torn bunkers, and sacrificial chambers. The island is rich with lore, danger, and haunting beauty.

Mystery, Lore & Exploration

Collect lost documents, uncover forbidden tech, and piece together the chilling truth behind the Vault, the experiments, and your own presence here.

Ritual Meets Science

The enemies you fight are not just undead—they’re engineered. Ancient rituals merged with wartime science created monsters that defy logic and nature. Destroy their source, or be consumed by it.

Vault of Fallen is built for players who crave brutal action, atmospheric worlds, and the thrill of mastering both blade and gun.
No help. No mercy. Just blood, steel, and the will to survive.

content_descriptors.notes: Our game has fast pace and high intensity gun fights, killing skeletons and demon bosses. Game doesn't include any sexual content or adult only content. Can contain blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 560 (2-4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 / RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Vault of Fallen is a brutal first-person action game set on a cursed island. Blast enemies with a powerful shotgun or slash through undead hordes with sword and shield in a fast-paced, dark fantasy world where science and sorcery collide. This demo does not include the final abilities of the player.
